stemMd: A material has density 2.7 g/cm cubed. What is this density in kg/m cubed?
explanationMd: One gram is 0.001 kg and one cubic centimetre is one millionth of a cubic metre. Their ratio gives a factor of 1000, so 2.7 becomes 2700 kg/m cubed.

distractorRationale.a: This converts mass but not cubic volume.
distractorRationale.b: Both mass and volume units must be converted.
distractorRationale.c: This uses a linear rather than cubic length conversion.
distractorRationale.d: This misses a factor of ten.
